purpose: Predeclared offline comparison using saved v18 observations, never a new OCR or UI acceptance run
observationClock: Original integer PTS; decisions occur only on an observed frame, no timer guessed between frames
baseline: Keep v18 complete/menu/status/fading readiness; message completion is its existing arrow and unchanged-content latch. This is not a literal down-arrow-only rule for menus.
extension: Only message_loading gets the text-stability fallback; all other v18 readiness and transition rules are shared
signature: All raw text with role, readingOrder, gridRect, markCells, logicalRect, renderUnits, selection cursors and detached marks; exclude drifting sourceRect and blinking down arrows
invalidation: Invalidate pending/display candidate when signature changes or input leaves eligible states; no delayed flush at clip end and no history across gaps
residualFalseTrigger: A new nonempty candidate emitted on a frozen loading/message_loading frame (GT completePage false); keep separate from OCR text errors
otherUnsafeTrigger: A new candidate on any other frozen noncomplete transition; report all kinds separately
pageDetection: At least one ready decision on the page's frozen complete source frames; all duplicate observations must be ready. Text-correct detection additionally requires the existing strict-key text score to have zero edits.
shortPage: Sum of frozen complete-frame original durations strictly below 200 ms; report page span separately
delay: First ready or first text-correct ready source PTS minus first complete source PTS; report P50/P95/P99/max and >200 ms, misses separately. Excludes OCR computation, queue, translation and actual UI presentation.
thresholdSelection: Primary 100 ms is fixed before evaluation; other windows are an exploratory development sensitivity sweep, not independently validated tuning
standards: Do not alter GT, original v18 outputs, strict scorer, geometry budgets or acceptance thresholds
